Hi, b1 renewal and a5 question 

Today after sending many emails we got a call from MisradHapnim Ashqelon, my b1 visa is going to expire on November 10. We got a date for November 9 to come get extension and then for January 10 to come for an interview. 

We didn’t send any online form, just email. We are newly married couple. My husband asked if we need to bring something else, any documents and they said just to bring passport and his ID on November 9. 
How does it work? On November 9 I’m going to get the b1 extension then what for is the 10 January interview? I don’t understand it. And also should we bring some documents even tho she said no? When he said that we got married she said just to come and tell them there on the next appointment without any explanation on what to do.
